alignment.meaning: offset of the 1 MiB haystack slice within an overallocated runner buffer

background.sentinel: lowest byte in inclusive range 0x20..0x7e absent from the literal
background.repair: find the leftmost literal occurrence at or after cursor, replace its first byte with sentinel, set cursor=start+1, repeat to exhaustion

early.construction: repaired background, sentinel guard width-1 on each in-range side, then insert one literal

middle.construction: repaired background, sentinel guard width-1 on each in-range side, then insert one literal

tail.construction: repaired background, sentinel guard width-1 on each in-range side, then insert one literal

dense.construction: repeat the literal floor((1048576-1)/literal_width) times from offset zero and fill the nonempty suffix with sentinel

oracle.search: scalar overlapping left-to-right byte comparison; first start becomes the half-open leftmost span
requirements: early, middle, and tail have exactly one occurrence at the prescribed start
dense has exactly the prescribed nonoverlapping count and no extra occurrence in the sentinel suffix

backend_identity.timing_forbidden_until: V10 source, tag, object ABI, static linker, facade, and auto-routing policy are frozen
